programme.title: Super Taste: 48- Hour Burning Desire!
programme.desc: Taiwan's favourite food show returns with a fresh look, more great eats and crazy missions!

programme.title: Discover New Taiwan Step by Step
programme.desc: Hear success stories from Taiwanese in various fields, in this documentary that reveals the vision and passion that drives them to pursue their goals.

programme.title: Brothers Five
programme.desc: Superstar Cheng Pei-pei stars as Yen Lai, the one woman who can reunite the Kao brothers in a bid to save the Teng Lung Manor and avenge their father's death.

programme.title: Songfest
programme.desc: This Eastmancolor-Shawscope costume musical depicts a turbulent romance between Yu Lan, a passionate tea picker and a charming fisherman named Chun Yang.

programme.title: Legend of the Fox
programme.desc: This exciting tale of revenge features cameos from the director's three most popular 'Venoms,' Kuo Chue, Chiang Sheng and Lu Feng.

programme.title: Three Sinners
programme.desc: Based on the classic Ming Dynasty novel The Water Margin, this Huangmei Opera is a heady mix of love, betrayal, murder, and redemption.

programme.title: Pursuit of Vengeance
programme.desc: This fantastic tale of the fastest swordsman in the world is explosive as he takes on the '1000 Face Devil' and no less than seven murderers.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Three single females and the men they fall for think things are simple and blissful until the lasses' parents enter into the picture.

programme.title: Notorious Eight
programme.desc: This is a thrilling mix of martial arts stars, extortion, illicit love, vengeance and edge-of-your-seat gambling duels.

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This comedy contains dramatisations of some of the funniest and most surreal film gossips of director Li Han-Hsiang's 30 year career.

programme.title: The Lady Professional
programme.desc: Lily Ho stars in this movie as a revenge seeking gun-for-hire who always gets her man in more ways than one!

programme.title: Operation Lipstick
programme.desc: A motorcycle workshop owner feels compelled to damn the physical and legal consequences and go on racing.

programme.title: Raw Courage
programme.desc: First a hero and then his daughter try to protect Ming Emperor Jianwen infant son from rebels headed by Tien Fung.

programme.title: The Mirror and the Lichee
programme.desc: The film's curious title refers to two props that signal a happy beginning to what develops into a tragic love story, linking a scholar and a local beauty.

programme.title: The Emperor and His Brother
programme.desc: This epic depicts how Chen Chia Lo and his men set out to persuade the Qing Emperor Chien Lung to acknowledge his Han bloodline and join the anti-Qing movement.

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: Kung fu idols Wang Yu, Lo Meng and Loh Lieh star in this comedy set in a Shaolin temple where Hung Hsi-kuan and Fang Shih-yu become disciples.

programme.title: The Imperial Swordsman
programme.desc: This drama depicts the quest of four imperial swordsmen to stop a traitor from staging an invasion of China and taking over the nation.

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: An insane swordsman takes to making Chinese lamps from the skin of his enemies' sisters, mistresses and wives!

programme.title: The Flag of Iron
programme.desc: In this saga of two warring clans, Tsao Feng from the Flag of Iron betrays Lo, his master and teams up with the enemy. Unexpectedly, Lo returns for revenge.

programme.title: The Blue and the Black Part 2
programme.desc: This sequel captures how singer Tang Qi searches through battle-scarred China for her soldier lover, Xing Ya. However, are they fated to be apart?

programme.title: Purple Darts
programme.desc: A girl vows to take revenge against the 4 outlaws who murdered her parents when she was only a baby. To do so, she trains hard at martial arts and teams up with a swordsman to kill them.

programme.title: The Love Eterne
programme.desc: In this award-winning classic, a beauty disguises herself as a boy to attend school yet tend to her lover. Stars Lo Ti, Ling Po.

programme.title: Portrait in Crystal
programme.desc: Action - Tragic deaths in the underworld cause leader 'Yama' to suspect a portrait in crystal with mysterious powers. He sends Hen Pan and Pai Pan to interrogate its creator, martial artist Lung Fei.

programme.title: The Magnificent Concubine
programme.desc: An emperor's obsession with his consort distracts him, allowing his cruel prime minister who also happens to be his consort's brother, to run the nation.

programme.title: Journey of the Doomed
programme.desc: A swordsman bids to protect a beautiful princess while being stalked by a bunch of assassins. Starring Tung Wei, Kara Hui.
